apps.name: Calc
apps.description: Updates the OpenOS calculator interface and calculation logic.

apps.name: Clock
apps.description: Updates the OpenOS clock application and its time display.

apps.name: Control Center
apps.description: Updates Control Center and its quick controls for connectivity, brightness and system actions.

apps.name: Files
apps.summary: Browse and open files on the SD card.
apps.description: Updates the OpenOS file browser and file launching interface.

apps.name: Home
apps.summary: OpenOS home screen and app launcher.
apps.description: Updates the OpenOS home screen, app grid, folders, icon ordering and app context menu.

apps.name: Lockscreen
apps.summary: OpenOS lock screen and passcode panel.
apps.description: Updates the OpenOS lock screen, clock display and passcode interface.

apps.name: Notes
apps.summary: Create and edit notes on the SD card.
apps.description: Updates the OpenOS notes application, multiline editor and note browser.

apps.name: OpenStore
apps.description: Updates OpenStore with version compatibility checks, Update All, user applications, system application updates and OPK package management.

apps.name: Settings
apps.description: Updates Settings with signed firmware OTA, release notes, rollback, update-source controls and scrolling system preferences.

apps.name: 3D Cube
apps.summary: Rotating 3D cube demo for the OSA SDK.
apps.description: A lightweight rotating 3D cube that demonstrates the OSA pseudo-3D API. Tap the viewport to switch between wireframe, solid and solid-with-edges rendering modes.

apps.name: Lane Runner 3D
apps.summary: Dodge incoming cubes across three lanes.
apps.description: A lightweight three-lane 3D runner. Tap the left or right side of the screen to change lane, avoid incoming cubes and survive as the speed increases.

apps.name: Pong 2D
apps.summary: One-player Pong with touch paddle controls.
apps.description: A fast one-player Pong game designed for the OpenOS touchscreen. Drag the paddle, keep the ball in play and beat your best score.

apps.name: 3D Shapes
apps.summary: Full-screen 3D scene with five orbiting shapes.
apps.description: Five shapes orbiting on a grid, depth-sorted as one scene and rendered through a 240x40 band buffer so the whole 240x320 screen is drawn at 16-bit colour. Drag to orbit the camera, tap to switch between wireframe, solid and solid-with-edges. The reference for the OSA SDK 5 scene API.

apps.name: UI Kit
apps.summary: Widgets, dialogs and custom shapes from OSA SDK 4.
apps.description: A tour of the immediate-mode widgets (buttons, switches, checkboxes, radios, progress, chips), the redesigned system dialog and the custom shape calls (stars, polygons, pies, per-corner rounded rectangles and animated paths) added in OSA SDK 4. A reference for app developers.
